headline: Brent crosses $115 after a reported Houthi strike on a 550k-bpd Saudi refinery
so_what: India imports most of its oil, so this hits inflation, the rupee and the chance of RBI rate cuts. Biggest near-term risk to the index.

headline: Fed holds at 3.75–4.00% in a 10–2 vote. Two members wanted a hike.
so_what: US rates staying high keeps foreign money flowing out of India for now.

headline: Nifty ends near 22,699 (−0.2%). IT and energy drag, banks limit losses.
so_what: Support is 22,500–22,700 and the hurdle is 22,800. The index has been going sideways for 3 weeks.

headline: Jio Platforms lists at a ~21% premium
so_what: Strong appetite for Reliance-group listings despite the weak market.

headline: Rupee near 95.2/$. RBI dollar selling limits the slide.
so_what: A weak rupee supports your gold holdings in rupee terms.

headline: Jupiter Wagons wins a ₹1,140 cr railway ministry order. Stock +9%.
so_what: Railway capex orders keep flowing. Added to the watchlist.

headline: JIOFIN Q2: profit −51% to ₹340 cr, income +132%, Jio Credit loan book ₹37,320 cr
so_what: Lending is growing, but profit is lumpy. The stock is around ₹205, close to your exit level of ₹196.

headline: IRCON wins ₹862 cr EPC contract from East Central Railway
so_what: Order book ~₹23,366 cr. Still on the watchlist.
